narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a humorous and heartwarming family moment where a father helps his son recover from a minor fall. The core appeal lies in the funny revelation that the boy fell off the sofa because he was trying to 'become a chicken' by hiding his limbs, leaving him unable to break his fall.
